C0612.title: Chongqing Police Crack Credit Card Payoff App Cash-Out Scheme
C0612.summary: Chongqing police dismantled a case where an app generated fake purchase orders to facilitate malicious credit card cash-outs and repayments. The criminal group profited over 2 million yuan in a short period, with total cash-out amounts reaching 60 billion yuan.

references.title: Over 6 Billion Yuan Involved: Chongqing Police Crack Credit Card Repayment App Cash-Out Case
